test_title: PYST 07: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 8% per year rate of interest for 5 years."
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of interest (R) = 8% per year

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (₹3000 × 8 × 5) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹120000 / 100

⇒ SI = ₹1200

**The simple interest is ₹1200.**
